notice.title: Certificate Verification Schedule for the post of Pharmacist (Unani)- List 2

clauses.text: The candidates are called for verification of certificates / documents based on the marks secured by the candidates as claimed for in their online applications such as age, educational qualification, community, etc and other relevant rules in vogue

The provisional selection of candidates will be made only after verification / acceptance of certain documents, educational qualification possessed by him / her, clarification regarding community status and its acceptance, marks / rank list of the candidate etc. as the case may be
